name: Solomon USDv
oneLiner: USDV is Solomon Labs's synthetic dollar on Solana backed by Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral perp margin, with no permissionless public redemption rail.
collateral: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin used by Solomon Labs to back USDv
pegMechanism: USDv targets $1 through Solomon-managed strategy collateral, market liquidity, and approved/whitelisted participant redemption into USDC against a small documented protocol reserve buffer; no permissionless public holder redemption rail is disclosed

reserves.name: Ceffu-custodied strategy assets and off-exchange delta-neutral margin

notices.title: Aggregate reserve disclosure
notices.message: USDv has on-chain supply validation, but public attestations are aggregate and do not expose a live composition API. The modeled redemption backstop is limited to approved/whitelisted participants and a documented 0.5% instant reserve buffer; the live feed validates Solana token supply only, while reserve composition is Ceffu-custodied off-exchange and is not on-chain verifiable.

mintAuthority.summary: USDv is a synthetic dollar where only KYC'd approved market makers and institutions can mint or burn directly against Solomon's Ceffu-custodied delta-neutral collateral; general users enter and exit via Solana pools, and Solomon's programs and admin operations are governed by a Squads multisig.

controls.label: Solomon direct mint/burn permission (approved participants)
controls.evidence: Solomon docs state direct 1:1 mint/burn/redeem of USDv is permissioned to approved market makers and compliant institutions; Solana RPC returned this live SPL mint authority for token Ex5DaKYMCN6QWFA4n67TmMwsH8MJV68RX6YXTmVM532C and null freeze authority.

controls.label: Ceffu custodian (backing collateral)
controls.evidence: Backing assets for USDv (delta-neutral spot-long / perp-short positions) are held in segregated, insured custody with Ceffu, and Solomon's Solana programs are described as restricted to custody transfers with admin operations secured by a Squads multisig.

review.evidence: Solomon Labs operates USDv as a Solana-native synthetic dollar backed by a delta-neutral basis trade in Ceffu custody; direct mint/burn is permissioned to whitelisted KYC'd participants.
